description: Trigger a fetch of latest data from Plaid. An account is eligible only if its last_fetch is over 1 minute ago; calling again sooner returns 425 Too Early, so use this sparingly. Optionally scope the fetch to a date range (start_date and end_date must be provided together) and/or a specific Plaid account ID. The fetch runs as a background job, so the results are not immediate.

end_date.description: End of the date range to fetch transactions for (YYYY-MM-DD). Required if start_date is set.

id.description: If set, only fetch the specified Plaid account; otherwise all eligible accounts are fetched.

start_date.description: Beginning of the date range to fetch transactions for (YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, the most recent transactions are fetched. Required if end_date is set.

name: trigger_plaid_fetch
